message: The other day, I was cooking up a storm when my phone decided it was time to quit on me. No music, no timer, and definitely no emergency contacts if something went sideways. It got me thinking—what if I needed help? I made a mental note to jot down important numbers and keep them handy. Lesson learned: tech can be fickle, so I’d better have a backup plan in case of a kitchen mishap. Ever had a tech fail at just the wrong time?
